name: Jordan
source:
Jordan has only been playing goalie for a few years, but he is a natural at the position and one of his team's few bright spots in games. Unfortunately, he's also incredibly shy and blunt when he does choose to speak, so his defenders don't know how to best help him in the midst of a game. He enjoys playing with Paige because he never has to tell her where she needs to be.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=37386]Lemmasoftl[/url]]
